**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Review source-language collisions with saved corrections**

When an AI proposal changes an existing board-following card’s source language to the language of a protected correction (for example, `en-US` to `ru-RU`) and omits that language from `tile.translations`, this blindly retains the correction without reporting a replacement. `proposalTranslationReplacements` therefore returns no review item, while `tileInLanguage` chooses the new source words whenever the selected language equals `tile.language`, silently replacing the corrected Russian text and audio in actual use. Treat this source-language collision as a protected replacement or otherwise prevent the new source from shadowing the saved correction.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Addressed in `a08a723d87cee4bbb3026f11b3fcfa8c63c6f2ce`. An AI source-language change is now refused when it would shadow a saved manual/legacy translation, including when the proposal omits translations and when ordinary replacement review was approved. The error directs the parent to keep the source language and edit its translation. A core regression passes; a browser regression verifies refusal leaves every saved tile unchanged.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Block manual source-language collisions**

When a board-following card has a protected Russian translation and a parent changes its original language from English to Russian here, the translation is retained but becomes unreachable: `tileInLanguage` returns the source tile whenever the selected language equals `tile.language`, so playback silently uses the newly relabeled original words instead of the saved correction. The AI path now guards this collision, but this manual path does not; reject the language change or require explicit handling when a protected translation already uses the new source language.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Addressed in 1a7fa5e960f200fdae35339972cddad871ea0f06. Manual Save and Duplicate now use the same protected-source-language guard as AI application. Refusal keeps the saved board unchanged and the draft retryable. Added canonical-tag/manual/legacy unit coverage and a browser save/duplicate/recovery case; the fresh capture demonstrates the refusal. Full check passed with 296 tests; affected browser rerun is completing.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Document the translation-replacement permission**

Document that `replaceTranslations` changes the returned board by replacing protected manual or legacy translations and must only be enabled after explicit parent review. The current JSDoc describes picture-preview behavior only, leaving this non-obvious and potentially destructive new public parameter without its authorization contract.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L7-L9](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/ebae155ff0eda3ec611e65dfc937f425b27e60df/AGENTS.md#L7-L9)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Addressed in 1b4d2ebf0d5f046eef3dec1d03834e7b09bb707f. proposalPreview JSDoc now says replaceTranslations may replace protected manual/legacy translations only after explicit parent review of this draft, and distinguishes preview construction from persistence. Documentation-only change; runtime behavior is unchanged.
